answer: A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the nadir graph. Re-attestations are stored in jade and violet lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 158 impostors cost 939 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
